sources.entry: One Switch - Mac menu bar app that adds various switches to the Mac's menu bar.

summary.name: One Switch
summary.one_liner: One Switch is a macOS menu bar app that puts toggles for Dark Mode, hiding desktop icons, keep-awake, screen saver, and AirPods connection in one place.
use_cases: Hide a cluttered desktop with one click
Switch between dark and light mode from the menu bar
Keep a Mac awake or stop the screen saver
Connect AirPods to a Mac quickly
summary.what_it_does: One Switch adds several on/off switches to the macOS menu bar. Based on the page, it can hide desktop icons with one click, toggle Dark Mode, prevent the Mac from sleeping or showing the screen saver, and connect AirPods to a Mac. The page says the switches can also be turned on manually. It is listed in the awesome-mac list under Menu Bar Tools.
notable: Single menu bar place for multiple Mac toggles
caveats: Requires macOS Monterey (12) or higher (one section also mentions Big Sur (11))
Purchase requires a license; 7-day free trial offered before payment
